name: pulihin-video
description: Rakitan video demo PULIHIN (Remotion). Terpisah dari aplikasi di root repo.

scripts.studio: npm run scan && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run scan && remotion render src/index.ts PulihinDemo out/pulihin-demo-draft.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:tanpa-subtitle: npm run scan && remotion render src/index.ts PulihinDemo out/pulihin-demo-tanpa-subtitle.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --props=props/tanpa-subtitle.json
